mapper.sql: select tenant_id, revision, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time, deleted_by, deleted_time, deleted_flag, status, id, remark, group_code, common_group_id, group_name, group_type, organization_id, department_id from system_user_group as userGroup
mapper.select: select positionUser.created_by, positionUser.created_time, positionUser.updated_by, positionUser.updated_time, positionUser.id, positionUser.user_id, positionUser.group_id, user1.remark, user1.login_name, user1.status, user1.nick_name, user1.email, user1.phone from system_user_group_user as positionUser left join system_user_base as user1 on positionUser.user_id = user1.id where positionUser.group_id = #{groupId} and user1.deleted_flag = 'N' and positionUser.deleted_flag = 'N' and user1.nick_name like concat('%', #{nickName}, '%')

select positionUser.created_by, positionUser.created_time, positionUser.updated_by, positionUser.updated_time, positionUser.id, positionUser.user_id, positionUser.group_id, u.remark, u.login_name, u.status, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phone from system_user_group_user positionUser left join system_user_base u on positionUser.user_id = u.id left join system_user_group ug on positionUser.group_id = ug.id where ug.group_code = #{groupCode} and ug.department_id = #{departmentId} and ug.deleted_flag = 'N' and u.deleted_flag = 'N' and positionUser.deleted_flag = 'N'
